planPhases.title: Fix auth middleware: enforce Bearer prefix, remove eval(), add token length check
planPhases.notes: Rewrote isValidToken without eval using pure string/array ops. Enforced Bearer prefix check. Added >200 char token rejection. Build passes, auth tests pass. One unrelated test still fails (search timeout due to child_process.exec in controller — that is phase 2).
